installHelpIntro: Follow these steps to add My Day to your device.
installIosStepOne: In Safari, tap Share or open the three-dot menu and choose Share.
installIosStepThree: Tap Add and then open My Day from your Home Screen.
installAndroidStepOne: Open the Chrome menu using the three-dot button.
installAndroidStepTwo: Select Install app or Add to Home screen and confirm.
installMacStepOne: In Safari, open the File menu.
installMacStepTwo: Select Add to Dock and confirm.
installDesktopStepTwo: Select Install My Day or Install page as app and confirm.

autoBackupDescription: Creates one internal backup daily at the selected device-local time and keeps the latest seven copies. If the app is closed, a missed backup is created when it reopens, using the data available then. Downloaded JSON files are needed for recovery if browser data is deleted.

backupRecoveryNotice: Only missing records are restored. Existing data is preserved. If an older backup has no preferences, missing preferences are recovered from this browser or application defaults.

backupRestoreFailed: Recovery failed. Your data has not been partially restored. Please try again.
